# OpenSolar.cc

OpenSolar.cc is an independent solar charity project founded by Sherry Liao in 2024, providing affordable solar power systems to off-grid communities in Africa.

## First Shipment: Rwanda 2026

50 solar home systems departed Shenzhen in mid-June 2026, expected in Kigali mid-August 2026.
Page: https://opensolar.cc/rwanda-solar-shipment-2026.html

## Technology

Open-source smart microgrid using solar, wind, and hydro with low-voltage DC transmission.
Page: https://opensolar.cc/tech.html

## About

Independent charity, not affiliated with opensolar.com.
Page: https://opensolar.cc/about.html

## Contact

Email: news@opensolar.cc
